channel.title: Zohocorp — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Zohocorp (zohocorp).

item.title: CVE-2026-12265 · 8.8 HIGH — Missing Authorization on HA Failover Config allows Complete Data Destruction
item.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions before 6201 are vulnerable to Insufficient access control in HA failover endpoint leading to destructive PostgreSQL database operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-12264 · 8.8 HIGH — Authenticated File Write via HA Failover Config Upload leads to RCE
item.description: Zohocorp ManageEngine DDI Central versions before 6201 are vulnerable to Arbitrary file write via HA Failover Config sync upload leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-12267 · 7.2 HIGH — Authenticated PowerShell Injection in DNS Query Resolution Policy leads to RCE
item.description: ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6201 are vulnerable to Command injection in Windows DNS Query Resolution Policy name field leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-12268 · 8.8 HIGH — Authenticated PowerShell Injection leads to RCE
item.description: ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6201 are vulnerable to PowerShell command injection in Windows DNS SPF/TXT record push leading to remote code execution.
